candidates.issue: byed pa versus byed po in other verse witnesses
candidates.decision: No erratum: this exact source has BYED PA; ILL:1104 likewise byed pa, C14:129/C18:871 byed po. Nominal agent reading is supported by HGM byed pa maker. Variant does not prove error.
